notes: Excerpt holds the Schedule TO cover, the Offer to Purchase dated June 29, 2021 and the start of the Letter of Transmittal; it ends mid-instructions. Expiration July 30, 2021 is the stated date; no extension is stated in the excerpt. No amendment or final results in the excerpt, so result fields are null. Commencement date is not stated as such (offer dated June 29, 2021) so it is null. Offer size 19,931,845 is stated directly as 50% of outstanding; not computed. The filing also describes three subsequent conditional tender offers (10% of shares at 98% of NAV, Q4 2022-2024, triggered by a 10% average discount); these are not the offer this filing commences and are not extracted as events. trigger_origin is a reader judgment from the Saba agreement text. Conditions mapped by category: asset-coverage failure set to other; the banking-moratorium condition is not a listed span and is not in the conditions value (it could fit market_disruption or other).
